title: Solos, stomping off and keys in the early bands
summary: Tom explains there were no solos or singing early on, how he started tunes on violin, the keys F and B flat, and ensemble playing.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What to think while improvising: wrong notes and being in the moment

blocks.x: What about, when did they start taking solos? You know what I mean?
Solos, well, a year old lately they started taking solos. They had all that singing or nothing like that too. Nobody had nothing like that.
Well how would you play a number then? What would you do? Say you were just playing choruses. Who would take the first chorus?
Well I would play with, I'd just say I'll put it on my violin. If I'm going to play the tune I'm going to make it on my violin and they know when I'm going to play.
You see?
Yeah I see. I'll take a little violin and I'll... You'll sound it off.
I'll sound it off.
And they know when I'm going to play. And they got the key too. They got good ears.
They hear the key. Yeah, they know what the key is.

Yeah, they know what key I'm playing. F, most of them playing B flat. Yeah, F, B flat. They know how they're playing G. One time we were playing G and D when we started to buy music. You understand? But them tires and the slow dragging them tires and they're playing F and B flat. That's all. Yeah.
And then what would happen after you stomp off?
Well I'd do that. Get ready. One time to get ready. One time to get ready. And then I'd just talk. Everybody goes.
Everybody comes in.
One, two, three, everybody comes in. Now when I'm going to stop...
Hit hard, huh?
Yeah, hit hard. And then you know what I mean. Going out. Yeah, go halfway, you know, about three or four bars before I hit.
Well who would play the lead on the second chorus? Well... In those days? Of course.
We all played together. All played together, huh? All played together.
Would everybody play lead? No, well, vamp and second would have a lead then. The trombone plays part, and the vanger plays part. We wouldn't use no more in the part.

How they use the piano. Just started to use the piano here lately. You understand? Yeah. And we didn't have no drums. We wouldn't use that. We wouldn't use no sax, clarinet, violin, guitar and bass. Well what about it, would the clarinet play through the whole number? Well, that would make it a vibration. Yeah. Yeah, make it a vibration. Yeah, make it a vibration.
